{{Quote|You think killing beast impressive? Tu'chuk could kill ten beasts. Tu'chuk could kill you.|Tu'chuk|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tu'chuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Spearmaster]] who became a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[conquest of Makeb]] to lead the [[Army/Legends|armies]] gathering on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]]. However, Tu'chuk and the other three warlords&mdash;[[Sunder (mercenary)|Sunder]], [[Vilus Garr]], and [[Horic]]&mdash;were unknowingly hired by the [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Styrak]] and not the Cartel. The four warlords were [[Death/Legends|slain]] before Styrak's plans could advance beyond Darvannis.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tu'chuk appears as one of the Four Warlords, who collectively appear as the sixth and penultimate boss in the "Scum and Villainy" Operation. The Operation was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2012]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'',<ref name="TOR" /> and defeating the Warlords in various difficulty modes rewards players with painting-like trophies of the Warlords for use in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>
